choices.complete_month: a month is complete when prices.csv holds at least one trading day in a later month; the last month present is therefore never complete
choices.month_end_close: the close on the last SPY trading day of the calendar month, taken from prices.csv as given, no forward fill; a blank or non-positive close means no month-end close
choices.monthly_return: month-end close over the prior calendar month's month-end close minus 1; undefined unless both exist and the months are consecutive
choices.predicted_payer: any dividends.csv row for the ticker whose ex_date falls in calendar month m-3, m-6, m-9 or m-12; amount not consulted; rows for tickers absent from prices.csv ignored
choices.portfolio_membership: P, N and U are formed over stocks with a defined return in m; a month with fewer than 20 in P or fewer than 20 in N is skipped
choices.skipped_months_scope: counts.skipped_months counts the full computed range (2001-01 to the last complete month); the OOS-only count is under choices.alternatives
choices.first_last_oos: first_oos and last_oos are the first and last DEFINED OOS months, which equal the nominal bounds unless an end month was skipped
choices.newey_west: regression on a constant; Bartlett kernel; L = 3; weights 1 - l/(L+1); autocovariances divided by T; no small-sample correction; t = mean / sqrt(S/T)
choices.halves: the defined OOS months split by count; first half takes floor(n/2) months
choices.strategy_period: the defined OOS months, consecutive in the series (a skipped month is simply absent, so turnover is measured between the months on either side of it)
choices.turnover: one-way: half the sum of absolute differences between consecutive months' equal-weight target weights; the first month is bought from cash (turnover 0.5); cost = 2 * 10 bp * turnover deducted from P_m
choices.annualisation: geometric annual return wealth**(12/n) - 1; volatility and Sharpe use the sample standard deviation (ddof = 1) and sqrt(12)
choices.risk_free: monthly RF = product of (1 + RF/100) over the ff5_daily.csv rows in the calendar month, minus 1; Sharpe is computed over the months for which a monthly RF exists; the number lacking one is recorded
choices.max_drawdown: minimum of wealth / running peak - 1 on the cumulative monthly series; reported as a non-positive number
choices.counts_scope: counts.mean_P and counts.mean_U average over the defined OOS months; full-sample means are under choices.alternatives
choices.tickers: every column of prices.csv after DATE except a column named SPY, which is the calendar instrument and not a constituent
choices.verdict_when_insufficient: criteria.primary and verdict both read INSUFFICIENT below 120 OOS months; neither is coerced to FAIL
